svg.title: AIcoach landing page

text.tspan: Every swing
fault starts
somewhere in
your body.
Film one swing from down the line. AIcoach
finds the fault, traces it back through
your body to its likely cause, shows how
sure it is, and gives you one drill and
one mobility exercise.
Coaching, not diagnosis. AIcoach reads your swing from
video. It does not assess pain or injury.

svg.text: Plate 1. Impact, seen down the line

text.tspan: Early extension. Verified by
the rule table.
Turned 31° at impact, about
45° is typical. Likely
cause: restricted hip
rotation.
Moved toward the ball by 7%
of body height. Threshold
Example result, synthetic data: Rory, 11 handicap, 7-iron, filmed at 120 fps. The red route is the fault
chain, from the hip (A) through the pelvis (B) to the spine (C).

svg.text: A fault is the end of a chain.

text.tspan: A good coach asks what caused the fault, not just what it is. AIcoach
shows each link from likely cause to fault, the evidence behind it,
and how sure it is.
Not measurable directly. Pointed to by your lead
hip: turned 31° at impact, where about 45° is
typical.
Measured: 7% of body height from address to
impact. Key frames: address and impact.
Verified by the rule table. Your 7% is above the
4% threshold.

svg.text: It says when it isn’t sure.

text.tspan: Every measurement carries a confidence band. When the video cannot
support an answer, AIcoach says so instead of guessing.

svg.text: Red joint: the one the fault comes from
Translucent body: the pose in your video
Faint body: where you were at address

text.tspan: Face-on view detected. Feet out of
frame. Filmed at 30 fps. Each
reason links to the filming guide
step that fixes it.
Nelly, 4 handicap. Her swing has
none of the three faults. One
unverified observation: weight
appears to move toward the trail
side at the top.

svg.text: Unverified, confirm with a coach. No drill.

text.tspan: Loss of posture. Posture angle
changed 6°: past the 5° where it
becomes possible, short of the 9°
fault threshold.

svg.text: Shown with its confidence, but no drill.
Film one swing, down the line

text.tspan: Phone at hand height, 2.4 to 3.7 m back, on a
stable surface. Whole body and club in frame.
120 fps if your phone has it.
mp4 or mov, up to 15 seconds. AIcoach finds
your pose, the swing events and the
measurements, then checks them against the
rule table.
The fault, its chain and confidence, one drill
and one mobility exercise. Ask the coach
anything about it.

svg.text: Three faults, checked against a fixed rule table.

text.tspan: AIcoach verifies these three. Anything else it notices is labelled
unverified, with no drill.
Hips move toward the ball from
address to impact
Restricted hip rotation
Wall drill
90/90 hip rotation
Posture angle change in the
downswing, compared with address
Weak hip hinge or tight hamstrings
Alignment-stick head drill
Hip-hinge and hamstring mobility
Hand path in transition above the
backswing path
Upper body starts the downswing
Pump drill
Open books

svg.text: One drill. One mobility exercise. Equal weight.

text.tspan: The drill works on the fault you can see. The mobility exercise works
on the likely cause in your body.

svg.text: Plate 3. Wall drill, seen down the line
Plate 4. 90/90 hip rotation, seen from above

text.tspan: Set up with your backside touching a wall, or your golf bag. Make slow
half swings and keep your trail glute on the wall through impact.

svg.text: Trains B: it keeps the hips from moving toward the ball.

text.tspan: Sit with both knees bent at 90°, one leg in front, one to the side.
Keep your chest tall and turn your pelvis from the front shin toward
the back knee.

svg.text: Works on A: more hip rotation to turn into.
See a physiotherapist if you feel pain.

text.tspan: One swing clip is enough for a first answer. If the video is
not good enough, AIcoach tells you how to film it better.
AIcoach is a practice tool. It gives coaching, not diagnosis,
and its mobility exercises are generic guidance, not medical
advice. See a physiotherapist if you feel pain.

svg.text: Not for use during a competitive round
